sop_name: ISO 15118-2 TTCN-3 Test Code Generation SOP
description: Standard Operating Procedures for generating TTCN-3 conformance test code from ISO 15118-2 test cases. Uses a 5-Agent architecture (Orchestrator, Summarizer, Core Agent, Fault Corrector, Infrastructure Agent) with two-phase correction (compile/runtime), cross-platform build/run, and dual-track runtime analysis. Version 2.0 introduces Pure Static Data-Driven Pipeline: StaticExiDecoder replaces ExiCodecAdapter for decoding, using pre-computed JSON patterns with anchor-based EXI message identification and dynamic field slicing. Receive templates use lenient `?` pattern to accept any dynamic field values extracted from real SECC wire bytes.

phase_summary.generation: Orchestrator -> Summarizer -> Core Agent (direct to build)
phase_summary.infrastructure: Infrastructure Agent -> Build (static files copied from demo by pipeline)

steps.name: Intent Decomposition (Orchestrator)
steps.description: Analyze the test case JSON and decompose it into a structured TTCN-3 generation plan
details: Identify SUT type (SECC or EVCC) from test case
Determine message type and protocol layer (V2GTP, SDP, V2G Application)
Identify test type (GoodCase or BadCase)
Determine required precondition chain from SOP
List required templates (send and receive)
Identify timer parameters from message type
Determine expected verdict logic
Extract naming convention from SOP

steps.name: Knowledge Retrieval (Summarizer)
steps.description: Retrieve the most relevant TTCN-3 reference code from the knowledge base
details: Use pre-filtered results from local search by message_type and sut_type
Select reference testcase matching tc_id pattern
Select reference test behavior function
Select relevant send/receive templates
Select relevant precondition functions

steps.name: TTCN-3 Code Generation (Core Agent)
steps.description: Generate complete TTCN-3 module code (testcase + precondition/postcondition function files + aggregator modules). Follow the Mechanical SOP (step 3b) for every V2G application message exchange.
details: For every V2G application message: (1) lookup wire_hex in exi_payload_library.json, (2) send via structured union template, (3) receive via matching template, (4) stop timer before setverdict. NEVER manually construct V2GTP headers or raw octetstrings for V2G application messages.
Generate main test case module with tc_id as module name.
Generate precondition function files (one per entry in precondition_chain).
Generate precondition aggregator module (PreConditions_SECC_15118_2.ttcn) -- import-only, NO inline definitions.
Generate postcondition function files (one per entry in postcondition_chain).
Generate postcondition aggregator module (PostConditions_SECC_15118_2.ttcn) -- import-only, NO inline definitions.
Implement alt block: expected response (pass), unexpected response (fail), timer timeout (inconc).
Stop timer in every non-timeout alt branch. End test behavior with return getverdict.
Add @desc/@reference/@requirement documentation comments.

mechanical_sop.substep_1_lookup: Read exi_payload_library.json. For the message type under test, record: (a) wire_hex, (b) is_dynamic flag, (c) feature_pattern anchor bytes, (d) dynamic_field_offsets. If is_dynamic==true, note SessionID patching is automatic.
mechanical_sop.substep_2_template: Locate md_CMN_{Msg}Req_001 (send) in SECC_CmnTemplates.ttcn. For receive, use the lenient template `{ msgRes := ? }` -- StaticExiDecoder extracts dynamic field values from wire bytes and the lenient template accepts any values from real SECCs.
mechanical_sop.substep_3_send_union: Send via structured union ONLY: pt_V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_SECC_Port.send({ msgType := md_CMN_MsgReq_001 }). PROHIBITED: raw octetstrings, int2oct for V2GTP headers, hex literals on TCP port.
mechanical_sop.substep_4_receive_verdict: Receive via lenient union template: receive({ resType := ? }). Stop timer. setverdict(pass/fail). return getverdict. NOTE: The lenient `?` template accepts any field values. StaticExiDecoder extracts SessionID, ResponseCode, and EVSEID from wire bytes.

negative_constraints: MUST NOT use int2oct, '01'O, 'FE'O, '8001'O in TTCN-3 for V2GTP header construction
MUST NOT send raw octetstring literals to the TCP port for V2G application messages
MUST NOT use openv2g encoder or X-Macro mapping -- StaticExiDecoder handles encoding/decoding via static JSON patterns
MUST NOT hardcode ResponseCode, SessionID, or EVSEID values in receive templates -- use lenient `?` template
MUST NOT define functions inside aggregator modules (PreConditions/PostConditions) -- import-only
MUST NOT use transitive imports -- main TC module must directly import every function module called
steps.sdpremark: SDP messages (UDP port) are the ONLY exception to substep_3: use raw octetstrings on pt_V2G_UDP_SDP_Port. NOTE: After SDP discovery, the TCP adapter reads the dynamic port from V2G__UDP__SDP__Port__last_secc_port_ and adds a 75ms guard delay before connecting.

steps.name: V2G Message Exchange Mechanical SOP
steps.description: For every V2G application message exchange, execute these four sub-steps in order. Do not skip, merge, or reorder steps. SDP (UDP) is the ONLY exception to this SOP.

mechanical_sop.substep_1_lookup: Read exi_payload_library.json. For the message type under test, record: (a) wire_hex, (b) is_dynamic flag, (c) json_payload field values. If is_dynamic==true, note SessionID patching is automatic by ExiCodecAdapter.
mechanical_sop.substep_2_template: Locate md_CMN_{Msg}Req_001 (send) and md_CMN_{Msg}Res_001 (receive) in SECC_CmnTemplates.ttcn. Verify field values match json_payload from step 1.
mechanical_sop.substep_3_send_union: Send via structured union ONLY: pt_V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_SECC_Port.send({ msgType := md_CMN_MsgReq_001 }). PROHIBITED: raw octetstrings, int2oct for V2GTP headers, hex literals on TCP port.
mechanical_sop.substep_4_receive_verdict: Receive via matching union: receive({ resType := mdw_SECC_MsgRes_001 }). Stop timer. setverdict(pass/fail). return getverdict.

negative_constraints: MUST NOT use int2oct, '01'O, 'FE'O, '8001'O in TTCN-3 for V2GTP header construction
MUST NOT send raw octetstring literals to the TCP port for V2G application messages
MUST NOT use openv2g encoder or X-Macro mapping -- ExiCodecAdapter handles encoding
MUST NOT define functions inside aggregator modules (PreConditions/PostConditions) -- import-only
MUST NOT use transitive imports -- main TC module must directly import every function module called
steps.sdpremark: SDP messages (UDP port) are the ONLY exception to substep_3: use raw octetstrings on pt_V2G_UDP_SDP_Port.

steps.name: Build & Run (Pipeline)
steps.description: Compile and execute the TITAN test project; optionally capture PCAP during execution
steps.platform_detection: auto (Windows: cmd /c build.bat, Linux: bash build.sh)
details: Step 0: Check TITAN toolchain (makefilegen, ttcn3_compiler, ttcn3_executor)
Step 1: Detect platform and select build script
Step 2: Copy C++ adapter files from demo/ to build/generated_cpp/
Step 3: Execute build script, capture stdout/stderr
Step 4: Parse and classify compile errors
Step 5: If compile succeeds, run TestExecution with titan_runtime.cfg
Step 6: Stop sniffer, save capture.pcap
Save build.log to logs/system_logs/
Read TestExecution.log from logs/titan_traces/

steps.name: Compile Error Repair Loop (Fault Corrector, phase=compile)
steps.description: Analyze TITAN compilation errors with dual-agent classification; iterate: Core Agent + Infrastructure Agent fixes (max 3 rounds)
details: Step 1: Classify each error by source using classify_error_source()
- core/unknown errors -> Core Agent
- infrastructure/unknown errors -> Infrastructure Agent
- Error keywords: makefile/gcc/config/port adapter -> infrastructure; .ttcn/syntax/template/function -> core
Step 2: Build filtered error feedback for each agent
- build_core_error_feedback(): filters core + unknown errors
- build_infra_error_feedback(): filters infrastructure + unknown errors
Step 3: Call Core Agent with filtered errors (if core/unknown errors exist)
Step 4: Call Infrastructure Agent with filtered errors (if infrastructure/unknown errors exist)
Step 5: Both agents use is_fix_mode=True for simplified prompts
Step 6: Re-run build
Step 7: Call Fault Corrector for additional analysis if needed
Loop until compilation succeeds or max iterations (3) reached

error_classifier_patterns.fix: Define port type in ComponentsAndPorts.ttcn; match port name exactly
Add import from <module_name> all; at module top
Check template parameter types and function signatures
Ensure runs on component type matches caller; called function must use same or parent type
Ensure tc_X.start() is called before referencing timeout
Check TTCN-3 syntax: braces, semicolons, keywords; see TITAN ReferenceGuide Ch.3
Check C++ adapters in cpp_adapters/ for missing method implementations

steps.name: Runtime Analysis (Fault Corrector, phase=runtime)
steps.description: Dual-track root cause analysis using TTCN-3 log and PCAP capture
details: Track 1: Parse TTCN-3 TestExecution.log, extract verdict sequence, identify first failure
Track 2: Parse PCAP capture, reconstruct V2GTP message sequence
Cross-validate: Align TTCN-3 send events with PCAP packets, report divergence points
Correlate TTCN-3 timestamps with PCAP timestamps
Classify fault into 6 types: verdict_mismatch, timeout, protocol_error, timer_issue, assertion_failure, unknown
Generate repair suggestions using RepairEngine
Update titan_troubleshooting_db.json with new patterns (self-learning)

repair_types.auto_fix: Automatically apply suggested code replacement to source
repair_types.manual_review: Provide fix suggestion but do not auto-apply (complex semantic changes)

steps.name: Self-Repair (Pipeline)
steps.description: Automatically apply auto_fix repairs from Fault Corrector runtime phase; re-compile and validate (max 2 rounds)
details: Filter repairs by type == 'auto_fix' with both current_code and suggested_code
Apply code replacements to ttcn3_code
Write updated code to both output path and project src/ttcn3/ path
Re-run build (Step 5)
If build succeeds: record repairs to knowledge base (learn_from_repair)
If build fails: rollback to original code, report repair failure
Max self-repair iterations: 2

iteration_loops.description: The pipeline uses two iteration loops at different stages

large_loop_compile.name: Compile Error Repair Loop (Dual-Agent)
large_loop_compile.flow: Build fails -> Classify errors by source -> Core Agent (core errors) + Infrastructure Agent (infra errors) -> Re-build -> Repeat
large_loop_compile.exit_condition: Compilation succeeds or max 3 iterations reached
key_changes: Errors are classified by source before distribution
Core Agent handles: TTCN-3 code errors (.ttcn, syntax, templates, functions)
Infrastructure Agent handles: build/config errors (makefile, gcc, port adapters)
Both agents use simplified fix_mode prompts
Unknown errors are sent to both agents

large_loop_runtime.name: Runtime Self-Repair Loop
large_loop_runtime.flow: Test executes with failure -> Fault Corrector (runtime) dual-track analysis -> Self-Repair applies fixes -> Re-build+run -> Repeat
large_loop_runtime.exit_condition: Test passes, max iterations reached, or fault type requires manual review

fault_corrector.description: Unified Fault Corrector covering two phases with a single entry point

compile.trigger: TITAN compilation failed (raw error output available)

runtime.trigger: TITAN test execution completed (log + optional PCAP available)
runtime.method: Dual-track analysis: TTCN-3 log + PCAP + Python correlator + LLM reasoning

python_components.correlator: Align TTCN-3 log events with PCAP packets by timestamp
python_components.fault_classifier: Classify fault into 6 types with confidence score
python_components.repair_engine: Generate repairs from classified fault + source code

module.note: Same as testcase name; module name must match the testcase ID

aggregator_module.note: Aggregator modules (PreConditions_SECC_15118_2, PostConditions_SECC_15118_2) must ONLY import individual function modules. They must NOT contain inlined function definitions.
aggregator_module.correct: module PreConditions_SECC_15118_2 { import from f_SECC_CMN_PR_InitConfiguration_001 all; }
aggregator_module.reason: Inlined definitions cause 'module already defined' errors when Core Agent also writes function files. Aggregators must be import-only.

send_template.note: Common templates used by both SECC and EVCC tests

timer.note: Single timer instance per test behavior function

protocol_constants.note: SDP uses payloadType 0x9000; V2G application messages use 0x8001. The V2GTP header is handled automatically by StaticExiDecoder inside V2G_TCP_TLS_Port. TTCN-3 code must NOT construct V2GTP headers manually. SECC listens on dynamic port (e.g., 62897) advertised via SDP -- the TCP adapter reads V2G__UDP__SDP__Port__last_secc_port_ and adds 75ms guard delay.

common_errors.error: Missing timer stop in alt branch
common_errors.fix: Add tc_*.stop before setverdict in every non-timeout alt branch

common_errors.error: Wrong port name for SUT type
common_errors.fix: SECC tests use pt_V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_SECC_Port, EVCC tests use pt_V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_EVCC_Port

common_errors.error: Missing return getverdict in test behavior function
common_errors.fix: Always end test behavior function with 'return getverdict;'

common_errors.error: Using 'omit' in receive template where '?' is needed
common_errors.fix: 'omit' means field must be absent; '?' means any value; '*' means optional (present or absent)

common_errors.error: Wrong component type in runs on clause
common_errors.fix: SECC tests: runs on SECCTester system SystemSECC; EVCC tests: runs on EVCCTester system SystemEVCC

common_errors.error: Incorrect precondition chain
common_errors.fix: V2GTP/SDP tests need only InitConfiguration precondition; V2G application message tests need the full chain up to the target message. Transport-layer tests (TCP, TLS) need no preconditions.

common_errors.error: Port type not defined in ComponentsAndPorts.ttcn
common_errors.fix: Ensure port name used matches exactly with the declaration in ComponentsAndPorts.ttcn. Port must be defined as: type port <Name> message { out ...; in ...; }

common_errors.error: Module not imported
common_errors.fix: Add 'import from <module_name> all;' at the top of the module. Common imports: SECC_TestSystem, SECC_CmnTemplates, SECC_Constants, SECC_Types

common_errors.error: runs on clause mismatch between testcase and function/altstep
common_errors.fix: All called functions and altsteps must use the same runs on component type as the testcase. If testcase runs on SECCTester, all functions must runs on SECCTester

common_errors.error: Timer referenced before start() is called
common_errors.fix: Ensure tc_X.start() is called before any timeout branch is reachable. Timer must be started before it can timeout

common_errors.error: C++ adapter method not implemented (undefined reference in linking)
common_errors.fix: Implement the corresponding method in the C++ adapter .cc file under src/cpp_adapters/. Check for duplicate definitions across multiple .cc files

common_errors.error: Template type mismatch (parameter count or type)
common_errors.fix: Ensure the template instantiation matches the template declaration exactly: same number of parameters, correct parameter types, matching optional/omit fields

common_errors.error: Alt block does not handle all port operations
common_errors.fix: Every send/receive/check operation on a port must be covered by a corresponding alt branch. TITAN flags incomplete alt blocks at compile time

common_errors.error: No local or imported definition for function X (transitive import failure)
common_errors.fix: TTCN-3 does NOT re-export symbols through import chains. The main TC module must directly import the function module: add 'import from <module_name> all;' to the main TC file. Aggregator module imports do NOT make symbols visible to the TC module.

common_errors.error: Octetstring value contains odd number of hexadecimal digits
common_errors.fix: In TTCN-3, an octetstring MUST have an even number of hex characters (e.g., each byte is 2 chars). If a raw EXI payload hex string has an odd length, you MUST pad it with a single '0' (or '00') at the end to make the length even before compiling. Never use dummy placeholders like '0022'O as they cause EXI decoding EOF exceptions.

common_errors.error: ComponentsAndPorts.ttcn uses octetstring for V2G_TCP_TLS_Port instead of V2G_MessageUnion
common_errors.fix: Change to: type port V2G_TCP_TLS_Port message { out V2G_MessageUnion; in V2G_MessageUnion; }

common_errors.error: Agent constructs V2GTP header manually in TTCN-3 using int2oct or hex concatenation
common_errors.fix: Delete the manual V2GTP construction. Send via structured union template instead. The C++ port adapter (ExiCodecAdapter inside V2G_TCP_TLS_Port) handles V2GTP header and EXI encoding automatically.

common_errors.error: Agent sends raw octetstring to TCP port for V2G application message
common_errors.fix: Use structured union: pt_V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_SECC_Port.send({ msgType := md_CMN_MsgReq_001 }). Raw octetstrings are ONLY for SDP (UDP port).

common_errors.error: undefined reference to `ExiCodecAdapter::encode(std::string const&, ...)`
common_errors.fix: C++ ABI mismatch between port adapter (new-ABI ExiCodecAdapter) and TITAN-generated code (old-ABI). Solution: (1) Add ExiCodecAdapter::encode(const char* key, const std::string& sid, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) overload in ExiCodecAdapter.hh/.cc, (2) Call it as encode(key_literal, session_id, wire_output) from the port adapter. This avoids passing const char* through std::string constructor.

common_errors.error: undefined reference to `V2G__UDP__SDP__Port__last_secc_ip_`
common_errors.fix: Global variable declared as 'extern std::string' but never defined. Add the definition (not extern) in V2G_UDP_SDP_Port.cc: 'std::string V2G__UDP__SDP__Port__last_secc_ip_;' outside any namespace.

common_errors.error: std::string ABI mismatch between object files (undefined reference with [abi:cxx11] suffix)
common_errors.fix: Force old ABI across all object files. Add -D_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0 to both CXXFLAGS and LDFLAGS in Makefile. Example: sed -i 's|^CXXFLAGS = -Wall  $|CXXFLAGS = -Wall -I. -D_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0 |' Makefile

common_errors.error: no member named 'SELECTION' in SECC__Types::V2G__MessageUnion
common_errors.fix: TITAN union API uses get_selection() method, not SELECTION(). Change send_par.SELECTION() to send_par.get_selection() and use enum values like V2G__MessageUnion::ALT_sessionSetupReq.

common_errors.error: incomplete type 'SECC__TestSystem::ExiCodecAdapter' used in nested name specifier
common_errors.fix: ExiCodecAdapter is defined in global namespace, not SECC__TestSystem. Use ::ExiCodecAdapter::instance() instead of ExiCodecAdapter::instance(). Forward declare it inside namespace SECC__TestSystem { class ExiCodecAdapter; } before use.

common_errors.error: incoming_message(OCTETSTRING&) has no candidate
common_errors.fix: V2G_TCP_TLS_Port's base class expects incoming_message(V2G__MessageUnion&), not OCTETSTRING. For the demo adapter, log received bytes but do NOT call incoming_message() since decoding wire bytes to V2G_MessageUnion requires a full EXI decoder (out of scope).

common_errors.error: Connection refused on port 15118 after SDP discovery
common_errors.fix: The SECC listens ONLY on the dynamic port returned by SDP (e.g., 62897), NOT port 15118. The TCP adapter reads V2G__UDP__SDP__Port__last_secc_port_ (set by V2G_UDP_SDP_Port after SDP response) for the initial TCP connect. Add 75ms guard delay after SDP before TCP handshake. Cache the actual peer port via getpeername() for reconnection.

common_errors.error: Receive template mismatch: hardcoded EVSEID/ResponseCode/SessionID
common_errors.fix: Use lenient template `{ msgRes := ? }` in the receive alt branch. StaticExiDecoder extracts dynamic field values (SessionID, ResponseCode, EVSEID) from wire bytes. The lenient `?` template accepts any values. Do NOT hardcode response codes like ResponseCode := 0 or EVSEID := 'EVSE12345678' in receive templates -- real SECCs use different values.

common_errors.error: Core Agent uses set_parameter() or port API to persist protocol state
common_errors.fix: Protocol state (SessionID, EVSEID, SAScheduleTupleID, etc.) MUST be stored in TTCN-3 component variables (vc_ prefix) declared in ComponentsAndPorts.ttcn. The C++ adapter is a stateless translator. NEVER use set_parameter() or get_param() to store or retrieve protocol state. Violation: ExiCodecAdapter static Fallback cannot reliably reconstruct EXI with modified state.

common_errors.error: Core Agent uses wildcard receive without extracting protocol state to a component variable
common_errors.fix: After receiving a response that carries a state value needed later (e.g., SessionID from SessionSetupRes), the Core Agent MUST: (1) assign the decoded Union payload to a concrete Record variable via explicit branch matching, (2) immediately assign the relevant field to a vc_ component variable, (3) use the vc_ variable in subsequent sends. Do NOT rely on C++ adapter state or log parsing as the extraction mechanism.

common_errors.error: Core Agent injects component variable directly without using valueof(template) as intermediate
common_errors.fix: When injecting a vc_ component variable into a request, first instantiate the template with valueof(template_name), assign the component variable to the target field of the resulting record, then wrap in Union and send. Never inline vc_ directly in send() argument. Correct: var ServiceDiscoveryReq v_req := valueof(md_CMN_ServiceDiscoveryReq_001); v_req.sessionID.content := vc_SessionID; pt_V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_SECC_Port.send({ serviceDiscoveryReq := v_req });

precondition_chains.description: Precondition chain for each V2G message type. Each chain must be completed in order before testing the target message.

V2GTP.description: f_{SUT}_CMN_PR_InitConfiguration_001 includes: (1) port mapping, (2) SDP discovery via UDP (mandatory -- SECC must be found before TCP connect). V2GTP/SDP tests need only this precondition. Without SDP, the SECC never opens its TCP port.

_missing_precondition_chains.description: Message types that are not standard V2G application layer messages but may appear in test cases. These do not require full precondition chains.

V2GTP.description: V2GTP layer tests - only InitConfiguration needed
V2GTP.note: V2GTP requires TCP connection, which is established by InitConfiguration (includes SDP + TCP handshake)

SDP.description: Service Discovery Protocol tests - only InitConfiguration needed

SDPProvider.description: SDP Provider tests - only InitConfiguration needed

TCP.description: TCP connection tests - no precondition needed
TCP.note: TCP connection tests verify basic TCP transport without V2GTP
